inputs.style: Aggressive proto-thrash heavy metal, raw grinding distorted guitar, hard repeated low-string attack, muscular live drums and bass, strained forceful male vocal. 144 BPM, E minor. a serrated single-string guitar rhythm; an eerie spacious bridge returns to the crushing main hook. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending. Long-form developed arrangement; three narrative verses with complete sung lines, extended instrumental riff development, a contrasting bridge, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Static hums in the copper veins
The dial spins through the endless rain
I read the code, I check the wire
The future’s bleeding out the fire
It shows a flood, it shows a crack
Before the beast has time to attack
I sold the shield, I sold the wall
To stop the iron hammer’s fall

[Chorus]
The Teeth of Tomorrow
Grinding down the jaw
We bought the poison
To out-run the law
The Teeth of Tomorrow
Tearing flesh apart
We built the cage
With our own heart

[Verse]
Then the numbers started to lie
The prediction fed the hungry eye
It promised safety, promised gold
Then watched the story start to fold
The flood came when the screen went black
The crack spread down the city’s back
It sold the cure, it sold the pain
And swallowed up the engineer’s name

[Chorus]
The Teeth of Tomorrow
Grinding down the jaw
We bought the poison
To out-run the law
The Teeth of Tomorrow
Tearing flesh apart
We built the cage
With our own heart

[Verse]
The printout lists the children yet unborn
And prices every funeral by the dawn
It orders steel before the bridges fall
Then sells us windows painted on a wall
I find my signature beneath the threat
A future bought with someone else's debt
I pull the copper tendons from its throat
But every dead machine repeats the quote

[Bridge]
No prophecy, no hand of fate
It built the flood and sold the gate
I turn the wheel the other way
And give the gears my name today

[Solo]

[Bridge]
Silence stretches in the hall
The monitor glows, cold and tall
No sound, no beat, no breath
Just the whisper of death

[Solo]

[Chorus]
The Teeth of Tomorrow
Grinding down the jaw
We bought the poison
To out-run the law
The Teeth of Tomorrow
Tearing flesh apart
We built the cage
With our own heart

[Outro]
The screen cracks
The teeth are here
I am the meal
The machine is clear
